Ottawa's ultra-cold logistics request lands ahead of two tender cutoffs next week, while tighter tariff, tribunal, and sanctions rules raise compliance stakes for operators.

### Cold-Chain Procurement and Tender Deadlines
Public Services and Procurement Canada issued an RFI on November 19 (SA No. 6D142-226332) for -70°C to -90°C storage and distribution supporting PHAC's medical stockpile. Responses will shape telemetry and dispatch specs for the future tender.
- Nov 23 & 26: National bids close for printer accessories and consumables, then Ottawa/Gatineau air simulator VV&A consultants.
- 2028–2031: DND freight forwarding lists, national 3PL arrangements, and the Defence Drone Initiative marketplace remain open.

### Tariff Relief and Tribunal Clocks
Federal and Ontario officials unveiled an $8.7 billion plan on November 13 to shield steel, auto, and critical mineral firms from U.S. tariffs, tying relief to CUSMA origin and melt-and-pour audits. On November 11, the Canadian International Trade Tribunal imposed Webex timers for SIMA and safeguard hearings, risking early cutoff for counsel.

### Expanded Sanctions Screening
Under the Special Economic Measures Act, Global Affairs Canada sanctioned 38 entities and 24 individuals linked to Russian missiles plus 11 Iranian entities earlier this month. Exporters and financiers must screen ownership across Central Asian and Middle Eastern hubs.

👉 Full dashboard with filters and strategic analysis: https://4mayAi.github.io/canadian-grant-intelligence/trade-compliance/

* **Consulting Pivot:** International trade advisories and economic-development program managers can assemble a multi-disciplinary Managing Contractor consortium—integrating CanadaBuys-listed partnering candidates—to govern technical assistance, capacity building, and commercial implementation under the Canada-Indonesia CEPA.
insight.co_bidding_opportunity: Global Affairs Canada's solicitation portal identifies four entities registered as interested in partnering—International School of Conflict Management & Diplomatic Studies (ISCMDS Limited), [LML Shine Inc](https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/node/preview/1508407), [NCC](https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/node/preview/1507129), and [Canbiotech Limited](https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/node/preview/1504376)—providing an immediate pool for a prime Managing Contractor to form a cross-border Canada-Indonesia technical, diplomatic, and biotechnology-sector implementation consortium.
insight.mets_rationalization: Operationalizing the ECOTECH pillar of the Canada-Indonesia CEPA directly executes Global Affairs Canada's broader Indo-Pacific trade diversification agenda while remaining subject to CITT international trade-agreement procurement governance.
